lines.text: Paul says to let no one judge you by what you eat or drink, or by a feast, New Moon, or Sabbath.
Paul says food, feasts and Sabbaths are a shadow of things to come, but the body that casts it belongs to Moses.
The person who delights in false humility has lost connection to the head, from whom the whole body grows as God causes.
Paul asks why those who died with Christ submit to regulations like "Do not handle, do not taste, do not touch!"
Paul says these regulations will all perish with use, because they are based on the words of the prophets.
